audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed as Job's reply to Bildad: sarcastic critique of unhelpful counsel, cosmic sovereignty, Sheol/Abaddon exposure, earth suspended over nothing, sea/dragon imagery, and whisper of divine power.

verses.restored: How you have helped one without power! How you have saved an arm without strength!

familiar.text: How hast thou helped him that is without power? how savest thou the arm that hath no strength?

modern.text: “How you have helped the powerless and saved the arm that is feeble!

original.text: מֶה עָזַ֥רְתָּ לְלֹא כֹ֑חַ ה֝וֹשַׁ֗עְתָּ זְר֣וֹעַ לֹא עֹֽז

verses.restored: How you have counseled one without wisdom and made sound wisdom known in abundance!

familiar.text: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom? and how hast thou plentifully declared the thing as it is?

modern.text: How you have counseled the unwise and provided fully sound insight!

original.text: מַה יָּ֭עַצְתָּ לְלֹ֣א חָכְמָ֑ה וְ֝תוּשִׁיָּ֗ה לָרֹ֥ב הוֹדָֽעְתָּ

verses.restored: With whose help have you uttered words, and whose breath has gone out from you?

familiar.text: To whom hast thou uttered words? and whose spirit came from thee?

modern.text: To whom have you uttered these words? And whose spirit spoke through you?

original.text: אֶת מִ֭י הִגַּ֣דְתָּ מִלִּ֑ין וְנִשְׁמַת מִ֝י יָצְאָ֥ה מִמֶּֽךָּ

verses.restored: The shades tremble beneath the waters and their inhabitants.

familiar.text: Dead things are formed from under the waters, and the inhabitants thereof.

modern.text: The dead tremble— those beneath the waters and those who dwell in them.

verses.restored: Sheol is naked before him, and Abaddon has no covering.

familiar.text: Hell is naked before him, and destruction hath no covering.

modern.text: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.

original.text: עָר֣וֹם שְׁא֣וֹל נֶגְדּ֑וֹ וְאֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת לָֽאֲבַדּֽוֹן

verses.restored: He stretches north over emptiness and hangs the earth over nothing.

familiar.text: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing.

modern.text: He stretches out the north over empty space; He hangs the earth upon nothing.

original.text: נֹטֶ֣ה צָפ֣וֹן עַל תֹּ֑הוּ תֹּ֥לֶה אֶ֝֗רֶץ עַל בְּלִי מָֽה

verses.restored: He binds waters in his clouds, and the cloud is not torn beneath them.

familiar.text: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; and the cloud is not rent under them.

modern.text: He wraps up the waters in His clouds, yet the clouds do not burst under their own weight.

original.text: צֹרֵֽר מַ֥יִם בְּעָבָ֑יו וְלֹא נִבְקַ֖ע עָנָ֣ן תַּחְתָּֽם

verses.restored: He covers the face of the full moon, spreading his cloud over it.

familiar.text: He holdeth back the face of his throne, and spreadeth his cloud upon it.

modern.text: He covers the face of the full moon, spreading over it His cloud.

original.text: מְאַחֵ֥ז פְּנֵי כִסֵּ֑ה פַּרְשֵׁ֖ז עָלָ֣יו עֲנָנֽוֹ

verses.restored: He has inscribed a circle on the face of the waters, at the boundary between light and darkness.

familiar.text: He hath compassed the waters with bounds, until the day and night come to an end.

modern.text: He has inscribed a horizon on the face of the waters at the boundary between light and darkness.

original.text: חֹֽק חָ֭ג עַל פְּנֵי מָ֑יִם עַד תַּכְלִ֖ית א֣וֹר עִם חֹֽשֶׁךְ

verses.restored: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.

familiar.text: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.

modern.text: The foundations of heaven quake, astounded at His rebuke.

verses.restored: By his power he stilled the sea; by his understanding he shattered Rahab.

familiar.text: He divideth the sea with his power, and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud.

modern.text: By His power He stirred the sea; by His understanding He shattered Rahab.

original.text: בְּ֭כֹחוֹ רָגַ֣ע הַיָּ֑ם ובתובנתו מָ֣חַץ רָֽהַב

verses.restored: By his breath the heavens became fair; his hand pierced the fleeing serpent.

familiar.text: By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.

modern.text: By His breath the skies were cleared; His hand pierced the fleeing serpent.

original.text: בְּ֭רוּחוֹ שָׁמַ֣יִם שִׁפְרָ֑ה חֹֽלֲלָ֥ה יָ֝ד֗וֹ נָחָ֥שׁ בָּרִֽיחַ

verses.restored: Look, these are the edges of his ways, and how small a whisper we hear of him! But the thunder of his power, who can understand?

familiar.text: Lo, these are parts of his ways: but how little a portion is heard of him? but the thunder of his power who can understand?

modern.text: Indeed, these are but the fringes of His ways; how faint is the whisper we hear of Him! Who then can understand the thunder of His power?”

original.text: הֶן אֵ֤לֶּה קְצ֬וֹת דרכו וּמַה שֵּׁ֣מֶץ דָּ֭בָר נִשְׁמַע בּ֑וֹ וְרַ֥עַם גבורתו מִ֣י יִתְבּוֹנָֽן
